gloss: bit by bit; sparsely; in drops; here and there

definitions.gloss: bit by bit; little by little; gradually
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening slowly, one piece at a time, often in an unhurried or leisurely manner.
Describes things that are spread out with spaces between them, appearing intermittently.
Describes rain or liquid falling in scattered drops.

examples.japanese: ぽつぽつと{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: They started talking little by little.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}がぽつぽつと{集|あつ}まってきた。
examples.english: Customers started gathering one by one.

examples.japanese: {白髪|しらが}がぽつぽつと{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Gray hairs are starting to appear here and there.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}にぽつぽつと{街灯|がいとう}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Streetlights stand scattered along the road.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}にぽつぽつと{星|ほし}が{見|み}え{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Stars started appearing here and there in the sky.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}がぽつぽつと{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Rain started falling in scattered drops.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}にぽつぽつと{雨粒|あまつぶ}が{当|あ}たる{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of raindrops hitting the window one by one.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はぽつぽつと{過去|かこ}のことを{語|かた}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He slowly began to talk about the past, bit by bit.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}になると、ぽつぽつと{屋台|やたい}が{開|ひら}き{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: In the evening, food stalls start opening one by one.

notes:
USAGE:
ぽつぽつ(と) + verb

Sense 1 (bit by bit):
・ぽつぽつ{話|はな}す (to speak bit by bit)
・ぽつぽつ{始|はじ}まる (to start gradually)
・ぽつぽつ{集|あつ}まる (to gather one by one)

Sense 2 (sparse distribution):
・{白髪|しらが}がぽつぽつ{出|で}てきた (gray hairs are appearing here and there)
・{星|ほし}がぽつぽつ{見|み}える (stars are visible scattered about)

Sense 3 (drops of rain/liquid):
・{雨|あめ}がぽつぽつ (rain in scattered drops)

NUANCE:
Conveys a leisurely, unhurried pace with gaps between occurrences. Often suggests something is just beginning or happening intermittently.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ぽつりぽつり - Similar meaning (variant)
・ちらほら - Here and there, scattered
・ぼちぼち - Bit by bit, so-so (Kansai dialect)
